assistAttempts.changedStrategy: Used a post-prior-attempt SEC 8-K/exhibit source class rather than re-reading cumulative Q2 evidence; separated achieved technical milestone from still-unproven customer economics and commercialization.

learning.observed: A new SEC-furnished September 24 milestone resolved the prior factual uncertainty over achievement of 30 logical qubits.
learning.uncertain: Independent benchmark replication, customer economics and effect on external-capital needs remain unverified.
learning.improvementPath: Alpha can reuse the new primary source to distinguish reduced technical-roadmap uncertainty from still-open commercialization/financing risk without treating future falsifiers as current blockers.
learning.falsifier: If independent/customer evidence shows the milestone does not translate into useful workloads or if roadmap progression stalls, the reduced technical-risk interpretation should be revised.
